title: LA Galaxy × USC Career Trek
description: Toured the LA Galaxy's Dignity Health Sports Park with USC Iovine and Young Academy. Heard from AEG's talent team on building a career at the intersection of sports, entertainment, and design.

title: 🏆 1st Place — Newegg Gamer Zone Workshop
description: Won 1st place at the Newegg Gamer Zone educational tech workshop co-hosted with Western Digital and UGREEN. Competed in a hands-on challenge around NAS systems, data management, and next-gen gaming infrastructure.

title: Award — USC IYA Vibe Coding Hackathon
description: Competed alongside 70+ students in USC IYA's Vibe Coding Hackathon—14 interdisciplinary teams, four hours, live MVPs. Built a diabetes management text service and earned a prize for early customer validation and social impact.

title: Friends of Figma — Trivia Night
description: Joined the 4th Annual Friends of Figma Irvine Trivia Night. Familiar faces, genuine conversations, and new connections in the local design community.

title: PACSUN × USC Career Fest
description: Day 3 of USC Career Fest—visited PACSUN's HQ for an inside look at how the brand has evolved beyond beachwear, from global supply chain to visual merchandising and brand identity.

title: AI & Video — Lemonlight x USC IYA
description: Kicked off the Fall 2025 Professional Practices Residential with Lemonlight. Five intensive days exploring how AI is reshaping video production for top-tier brands including Rolex, Amazon, and Walmart.
